import cv2
import numpy as np

def ray_ground(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256) / 256)
    x_c = (u - 256) / 256 * z_c
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    wx = cam_x + z_c * np.sin(theta) + x_c * np.cos(theta)
    wy = cam_y + z_c * np.cos(theta) - x_c * np.sin(theta)
    return wx, wy, z_c

# Table center:
# In obs_0036 (cam at (1.73, 3.0), heading 180):
# Table has 4 legs. Let's find the legs on the ground:
img36 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0036.png')
# The brown table legs touch the floor at the bottom of the table mask
y36, x36 = np.where((img36[:,:,2] > 80) & (img36[:,:,2] < 150) & (img36[:,:,0] < 50))
# Let's see the two front legs bottom
bottom_mask = (img36[:,:,2] > 80) & (img36[:,:,2] < 150) & (img36[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 400)
yb, xb = np.where(bottom_mask)
print('Front legs: y in [', yb.min(), yb.max(), '], x in [', xb.min(), xb.max(), ']')
# Left front leg:
leg1_x = xb[xb < 100].mean()
leg1_y = yb[xb < 100].max()
# Right front leg:
leg2_x = xb[xb > 100].mean()
leg2_y = yb[xb > 100].max()
print(f'Front leg 1: ({leg1_x:.1f}, {leg1_y:.1f}), leg 2: ({leg2_x:.1f}, {leg2_y:.1f})')
wx1, wy1, _ = ray_ground(leg1_x, leg1_y, 1.73, 3.0, 180)
wx2, wy2, _ = ray_ground(leg2_x, leg2_y, 1.73, 3.0, 180)
print(f'Leg 1 pos: ({wx1:.2f}, {wy1:.2f}), Leg 2 pos: ({wx2:.2f}, {wy2:.2f})')

# In obs_0035 (cam at (1.73, 3.5), heading 180):
# Lamp pole:
img35 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0035.png')
# Dark gray pole on the right:
pole_mask = (img35[:,:,0] > 40) & (img35[:,:,0] < 70) & (img35[:,:,1] > 40) & (img35[:,:,1] < 70) & (img35[:,:,2] > 40) & (img35[:,:,2] < 70) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 400)
yp, xp = np.where(pole_mask)
print('Lamp pole center x in obs_0035:', np.mean(xp))
# Heading 180: ray angle = atan2(xp - 256, 256)
pole_x = np.mean(xp)
# Floor lamp base was at (1.10, 2.61) in frame 10. Let's verify!
# In obs_0014: cam=(1.0, 1.5), heading=0:
img14 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0014.png')
lamp14 = (img14[:,:,0] > 50) & (img14[:,:,0] < 90) & (img14[:,:,1] > 50) & (img14[:,:,1] < 90) & (img14[:,:,2] > 50) & (img14[:,:,2] < 90) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 420) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 250) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 350)
yl14, xl14 = np.where(lamp14)
print('Lamp bottom in obs_0014:', yl14.max(), 'center x:', np.mean(xl14))
wx_l14, wy_l14, _ = ray_ground(np.mean(xl14), yl14.max(), 1.0, 1.5, 0)
print(f'Lamp from obs_0014: ({wx_l14:.2f}, {wy_l14:.2f})')
"
